ambiguity_notes: Reason: attribution. The only qualifying finding (ICE 6/10 on Day 6) is documented in the same note as hypoglycaemia (BG 2.8 mmol/L, dextrose given 10 min before the ICE, recheck BG 5.1 only at 10:30). Hypoglycaemia is on the closed list (A35) and no clinician states a cause (A9). Reading A: finding counts, so record 'no ICANS' (compared as Grade 0 with no onset) gives grade 7.2 (documented 2) and onset 7.1 'record has no onset' (documented 2033-01-25, no signed difference). Reading B: finding excluded, no qualifying finding; formal Grade 0 assessments exist (ICE 10/10 on Day 3, 5, 7, 9 and 12), no 'not assessable' period, so both fields 7.7. Categories differ so 7.5. Tocilizumab is not a competing cause. Documented_value for the 7.5 fields is a summary (undetermined or range 0-2 for grade); the answer-format has no defined shape for onset under 7.5, so see readings. The v2 record is unchanged in value.
